limitations: Original is the whole-line reference; candidate is cross-row v3 with empty-block bypass, not the historical routed pair.
Reader II=1, loop depth=74 and publisher half-loop depth=2 are synthesis facts, not a complete cycle-exact state-machine extraction.
The 71-cycle minimum read-to-use floor is inherited and uncalibrated; treating loop depth as block drain remains an explicit nominal assumption.
The structural reader holds at most 74 segment descriptors, the shared AXI master has at most 16 pending reads, and the loaded FIFO has depth 16.
One registered loaded dequeue and two publisher startup cycles precede two II=1 packet writes; full publisher/control timing is not calibrated.
Only contiguous segment-aligned row intervals are admitted by this model; production HLS also masks historical unaligned intervals.
A later pairwise source-reader topology is not substituted for the frozen dedicated-reader basis.
DMA, launch/wait, inter-round host relaunch, GraSU maintenance and exact physical BO addresses are excluded. No FPGA or original-A4 timing match is asserted.
